drug_indication: Advanced Colorectal Cancer, Triple-Negative Breast Cancer, Estrogen Receptor-Low Breast Cancer, Solid Tumors
catalyst_text: FDA allowed IND to proceed for basket trial
detailed_catalyst_text: The FDA granted allowance to proceed for the IND supporting a Phase 1/2 basket trial of an IL-12 tethered TIL therapy. Planned cohorts include advanced colorectal, triple‑negative, and estrogen receptor‑low breast cancers, along with other prevalent solid tumors. This regulatory clearance enables initiation of first-in-human clinical testing in the U.S.
catalyst_text_evidence: "today announced allowance to proceed from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the investigational new drug (IND) application for a Phase 1/2 basket trial of IOV-5001, a next-generation interleukin-12 (IL-12) tethered TIL therapy." "Cohorts include advanced colorectal, triple-negative, and estrogen receptor-low breast cancers, as well as other highly prevalent solid tumors representing more than 100,000 U.S. deaths annually."

catalyst_text: Announced positive early data in advanced sarcomas
detailed_catalyst_text: Positive early results from a pilot clinical trial in advanced undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma and dedifferentiated liposarcoma were reported. Among the first six evaluable patients, confirmed ORR by RECIST v1.1 was 50% with responses deepening over time and a favorable safety profile. These findings suggest meaningful activity in a population with limited effective treatment options.
catalyst_text_evidence: Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc. ... today announced positive early data from a pilot clinical trial led by Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSKCC) and supported by Iovance of lifileucel in patients with advanced (metastatic or unresectable) undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma (UPS) or dedifferentiated liposarcoma (DDLPS) who were refractory to at least one prior line of systemic therapy. Among the first six evaluable patients treated with lifileucel monotherapy, physician-assessed confirmed ORR by RECIST v1.1 was 50%. Patients experienced deep responses that improved over time, consistent with lifileucel in melanoma, non-small-cell lung cancer, and other solid tumors. The safety profile was favorable and consistent with lifileucel therapy in other indications.

drug_name: Iovance TIL (LN-145) or lifileucel + pembrolizumab + chemotherapy
drug_indication: Cancer, 1L advanced non-small cell lung carcinoma
catalyst_text: 5/8/25- Trial ongoing. Cohort 3D results will inform registrational and confirmatory trial design.
The data from Phase 2 cohort 1a presented at ASCO indicated a confirmed complete response rate of 30%, as noted on November 8, 2024.
The Phase 2 data presented in the ASCO abstract indicated a confirmed ORR of 65.2%, which comprised 7 complete responses (30.4%) and 8 partial responses (34.8%), as reported on May 23, 2024.
The FDA granted approval on February 16, 2024.

drug_indication: Anti-PD-1 therapy for advanced (unresectable or metastatic) Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)
catalyst_text: Initial findings from Phase 2 of the trial indicated that the median duration of response had not been achieved. The treatment-related adverse events were in line with the existing disease and recognized adverse events.
Information published on May 31, 2019 indicated an ORR of 44% and a CR of 11%.
